about_the_game:
Animagi: Mage Builders is a real-time cooperative magical-building game. Team up with other mages on floating arenas and use the power of alchemy and runes to raise enchanted structures before chaos takes over.

Work together to gather resources, cast spells, and build living defenses while hordes of creatures — the Pragulentos — attempt to destroy everything you’ve created. Each match brings new challenges, unpredictable magical weather, and unique creatures that demand coordination and quick thinking.

Choose your Animagi, each with distinct abilities and magical styles, and evolve your mastery by unlocking new spells and staff upgrades. The goal is simple yet intense: build, protect, and endure until the very end.

⸻

Key Features:

• 🧱 Co-op Construction: build mystical structures in real time alongside fellow mages.

• ⚔️ Dynamic Defense: unleash spells, traps, and enchanted towers to repel the Pragulentos.

• 🌩️ Chaos Events: arcane storms, enemy mutations, and magical anomalies that reshape every round.

• 🔮 Unique Classes & Spells: customize your playstyle with elemental, alchemical, or spiritual magic.

• 🌍 Enchanted Environments: build across magical biomes like living forests, floating ruins, and arcane deserts.

• 🧙 Online Co-op Mode: join up to 4 players to overcome escalating challenges and earn legendary scores.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Online connection required for multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Stable Internet connection recommended for multiplayer. Optimized for 1080p 60 FPS.
